summary: Bearer may cast Blink, Shadow Step and Teleport on themselves while already Insubstantial from a State they caused and entered voluntarily.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Only if the bearer caused the initial Insubstantial State and entered it voluntarily. Assassin gets it as a Trait at 1st level; recorded as permanent.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Casting Blink, Shadow Step or Teleport this way removes the original Insubstantial effect (replaced by the new ability's).

references.name: Blink
references.note: May be cast on self while already Insubstantial.

references.name: Shadow Step
references.note: May be cast on self while already Insubstantial.

references.name: Teleport
references.note: May be cast on self while already Insubstantial.

clarifications.text: Using Trickery ends the original Insubstantial effect; the newly cast ability's effect replaces it.

open_questions: rules/magic-and-abilities/trickery.md gives Type Enchantment, but rules/classes/assassin.md lists 'Trickery (T)' at 1st level, 'Granted as a Trait'; duration recorded as permanent.
